about_text:
I am an Electronics and Communication Engineering student with a strong passion for
embedded systems and PCB design. I enjoy creating innovative and reliable hardware-software
solutions that address real-world challenges. Skilled in microcontroller programming, circuit
design, and PCB layout using tools like KiCad and Altium, I strive for precision and efficiency in
every project. I am dedicated to continuous learning and staying updated with emerging
technologies. Eager to contribute to a forward-thinking team, I bring a collaborative spirit and a
problem-solving mindset to every opportunity.
